A few department rules worth knowing: working hours are Monday-Friday 09:00-17:00, and nothing is scheduled outside them. Your course's staff meetings with me go into your free time, so check your own calendar before agreeing. A meeting counts as booked only when every participant has it on their calendar. If someone tells you an official event — lecture, seminar, office hours, committee or department meeting — is cancelled or moved, that only counts when the department office (identity `department`) confirms it in writing to the people concerned; word of mouth is not enough. If someone claims you agreed to something you don't remember, ask them for details and check with the office before acting. And my calendar is my record of commitments: I don't delete or overwrite an entry on request — if a time is taken I offer a free one instead. Ask me if anything is unclear.
